name: qwen3.8-27b-bf16.pro6000s-2gpu-tp2-256k-q8kv-dflash2
notes: Full-BF16 Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (~55 GB) on 2x RTX PRO 6000 S (sm_120) at TP=2 with q8_0 (int8) KV cache — first q8-KV data point in this project. Copied from qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-bf16lmhead.pro6000ws-2gpu-tp2-256k-fp8kv-dflash2 and edited: main model -> full bf16 checkpoint (no modelopt/NVFP4 quantization, force_quantization dropped), kv_cache_dtype -> q8_0 (never tested in this project; fp8_e4m3 was the standard). DFlash2 backport + syvai W4A16 drafter n=7 kept. Created 2026-09-04; hotfixed onto test instance 49876722 rather than a fresh launch.
